title: DFT Supercell Calculations for Formation Energies
action: Perform DFT supercell calculations for Si bulk, As substitutional, isolated vacancy, and all required defect complexes (V, AsV, As2V, As3V, As4V, V2, As2V2, As4V2, As6V2, As2I, As4I) using a plane‑wave LDA code in 32‑atom supercells, relax atomic positions, and obtain total energies. Record the raw total energies for later formation‑energy extraction.
description: Runs DFT calculations for all required defect configurations. This step must be performed before the formation energies can be computed.

title: Report Defect Formation Energies
action: Compute the formation energy (in eV) for each defect complex from the DFT total energies using the standard supercell formation‑energy formula with chemical potentials. Output the results in a CSV file.
description: CSV file containing the formation energies of all required defect complexes (V, AsV, As2V, As3V, As4V, V2, As2V2, As4V2, As6V2, As2I, As4I).
output_schema: Columns: defect (string, e.g., 'As2V'), formation_energy_eV (float), total_energy_eV (float), supercell_size (int). Must include entries for at least: V, AsV, As2V, As3V, As4V, V2, As2V2, As4V2, As6V2, As2I, As4I.

title: DFT Migration Barrier Calculations for AsV and As2V
action: Calculate the migration energy barriers for AsV and As2V using NEB or climbing‑image methods in 64‑atom supercells. For AsV: determine the energy change when the vacancy moves from nearest‑neighbor to third‑neighbor position and the bare vacancy migration energy. For As2V: compute the migration energy along the ring‑exchange pathways. Record the raw barrier components.
description: Performs nudged elastic band (NEB) or equivalent calculations needed to extract migration barriers. This step must be executed before the activation energies can be reported.

title: Report AsV and As2V Diffusion Activation Energies
action: Compute the total diffusion activation energy for AsV (formation energy of AsV plus the migration energy components) and for As2V (formation energy of As2V plus its migration barrier). Output the values as a JSON file.
description: JSON containing the migration barrier(s) and total activation energy for AsV and As2V.
output_schema: Top-level keys: 'AsV' and 'As2V'. Each value is an object with keys: 'migration_barrier_eV' (float, sum of barrier components), 'activation_energy_eV' (float, total diffusion activation energy = formation_energy + migration_barrier).
